name: orbit-thread
description: Token-efficient project setup, checkpoints and coding-session continuity.

interface.longDescription: Orbit Thread gives coding agents a small, durable continuity layer. Orbit Setup creates only missing PRODUCT, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and ROADMAP living docs, adds selective context-loading and bounded-subagent rules, and keeps local execution state separate from tracked project truth. Handoff overwrites a compact HANDOFF-STATE.md at verified checkpoints. Resume starts a fresh chat from the current handoff, read-only Git state and only the living docs needed for the task, reducing repeated context while preserving unfinished changes. Handoffs are capped at 50 lines, validated before atomic replacement, and the writer makes no network calls or Git mutations. Existing project docs and unrelated instructions are preserved. Orbit Next, an optional read-only remote MCP server, inspects public GitHub repositories to suggest prioritised next actions, diagnose failed CI runs and assess release readiness; it uses no accounts, AI inference or stored data, and is separate from the local skills.
defaultPrompt: Set up this coding project for continuity with lightweight docs and agent instructions.
Save a verified handoff with completed work, risks and the next steps.
Resume coding from the latest handoff, current Git state and relevant project docs.

publication.release_notes: Orbit Thread v1.3.0 adds Orbit Next, an optional read-only remote MCP server that inspects public GitHub repositories: prioritised next actions, CI failure diagnosis and release readiness. Setup, Handoff and Resume are unchanged and remain local.
